Hi Alice — thanks for sending the questionnaire. I started filling out the high-priority items and included a few notes inline (see attached partial response). A few quick answers to the items you raised: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted inference service; I’ve included a download link (see attachment RINF_SOC2_Attestation_Link.txt). We can provide the full report under an NDA.
- At-rest encryption: All model artifacts and customer data at rest are encrypted using AES-256. For customer-managed keys (BYOK), we support integration with AWS KMS and customer-owned CMKs (including HSM-backed keys via CloudHSM). Our guidance is to use an external CMK where Redwood’s service authenticates to a KMS endpoint with limited key usage permissions; keys never leave the customer's HSM.
- In-transit: TLS 1.2/1.3 with mTLS options for private deployments.
- KV cache considerations: For low-latency inference we use an encrypted KV cache; when customers use BYOK we encrypt cache shards with a per-instance key wrapped by the customer CMK so raw key material is not stored in plaintext.

Open items I’ll follow up on:
- Precise list of logs retained and retention windows (we have configurable retention; default is 30 days for request metadata, 90 days for full logs in hosted mode). We can offer log redaction/scrubbing for PHI on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Step-by-step BYOK integration doc and a short checklist for the POC (I’ll drop the integration guide link).

Proposed times for the tech deep-dive: Tue 2026-05-05 09:30 PT or Wed 2026-05-06 10:00 PT. Karthik will cover runtime access patterns and I’ll handle compliance/Q&A.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
